output_list.reason: The 'transferProxy' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function adds 'value' to 'balances[_to]' and 'feeSmt' to 'balances[msg.sender]' without checking if the addition causes an overflow, allowing attackers to overflow the balances of the contract owner and steal funds.

The 'approveProxy' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function sets 'allowed[_from][_spender]' to '_value' without checking if the addition causes an overflow, allowing attackers to overflow the allowed balance of the owner and steal funds.

The 'allocateTokens' function has a wrong logic vulnerability. The function adds 'value' to 'totalSupply' and 'balances[_owners[i]]' without checking if the addition causes an overflow, allowing attackers to overflow the total supply and users' balances and steal funds.
